50701-on-the-plantation-a-story-of-a-geo.description: A book by Joel Chandler Harris. To the little boy the stock of goods displayed for sale was as curious in its variety as the people who called day after day for the letters that came or that failed to come.

arxiv-2102-06477.title: HNPE: Leveraging Global Parameters for Neural Posterior Estimation
arxiv-2102-06477.creator: Pedro L. C. Rodrigues, Thomas Moreau, Gilles Louppe, Alexandre Gramfort
arxiv-2102-06477.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pedro L. C. Rodrigues, Thomas Moreau, Gilles Louppe, Alexandre Gramfort. Inferring the parameters of a stochastic model based on experimental observations is central to the scientific method. A particularly challenging setting is when the model is strongly indeterminate, i.e. when distinct sets of parameters yield identical observations.

arxiv-2206-03802.title: Motion control with optimal nonlinear damping: from theory to experiment Journal: Control Engineering Practice
arxiv-2206-03802.creator: Michael Ruderman
arxiv-2206-03802.description: Abstract Optimal nonlinear damping control was recently introduced for the second-order SISO systems, showing some advantages over a classical PD feedback controller. This paper summarizes the main theoretical developments and properties of the optimal nonlinear damping controller and demonstrates, for the first time, its practical experimental evaluation.

arxiv-2308-03438.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jack Smith. arxiv-2402-16477.title: Order p p quantum Wasserstein distances from couplings
arxiv-2402-16477.creator: Emily Beatty, Daniel Stilck França
arxiv-2402-16477.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Emily Beatty, Daniel Stilck França. Optimal transport provides a powerful mathematical framework with applications spanning numerous fields. A cornerstone within this domain is the p p -Wasserstein distance, which serves to quantify the cost of transporting one probability measure to another. While recent attempts have sought to extend this measure to the realm of quantum states, existing definitions often present certain limitations, such as not being faithful. In this work, we present a new definition of quantum Wasserstein distances.

arxiv-2504-15303.title: High-Throughput LLM inference on Heterogeneous Clusters
arxiv-2504-15303.creator: Yi Xiong, Jinqi Huang, Wenjie Huang, Xuebing Yu, Entong Li, Zhixiong Ning, Jinhua Zhou, Li Zeng, Xin Chen
arxiv-2504-15303.description: Abstract Nowadays, many companies possess various types of AI accelerators, forming heterogeneous clusters. Efficiently leveraging these clusters for high-throughput large language model (LLM) inference services can significantly reduce costs and expedite task processing. However, LLM inference on heterogeneous clusters presents two main challenges. Firstly, different deployment configurations can result in vastly different performance.

arxiv-2601-02477.title: Superextensive charging speeds in a correlated quantum charger
arxiv-2601-02477.creator: Harald Schmid, Felix von Oppen, Gil Refael, Yang Peng
arxiv-2601-02477.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Harald Schmid, Felix von Oppen, Gil Refael, Yang Peng. We define a quantum charger as an interacting quantum system that transfers energy between two drives. The key figure of merit characterizing a charger is its charging power. Remarkably, the presence of long-range interactions within the charger can induce a collective steady-state charging mode that depends superlinearly on the size of the charger, exceeding the performance of noninteracting, parallel units.

arxiv-2602-15535.title: Advanced Acceptance Score : A Holistic Measure for Evaluating Gesture Biometric Quantification
arxiv-2602-15535.creator: Aman Verma, Seshan Srirangarajan, Sumantra Dutta Roy
arxiv-2602-15535.description: Abstract Quantifying biometric characteristics within hand gestures involve derivation of fitness scores from a gesture and identity aware feature space. However, evaluating the quality of these scores remains an open question. Existing biometric capacity estimation literature relies upon error rates. But these rates do not indicate goodness of scores.

britannica-1911-alaric.title: Alaric (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-alaric.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-alaric.description: Article 'Alaric' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 1), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In the year 394 he served as a general of foederati (Gothic irregulars) under the emperor Theodosius in the campaign in which he crushed the usurper Eugenius. As the battle which terminated this campaign, the battle of the Frigidus, was fought near the passes of the Julian Alps, Alaric probably learnt at this time the weakness of the natural defences of Italy on her northeastern frontier.

pmc-11381804.creator: Amogh Verma, Amna Zaheer, Kiran Bisht, Abhay M Gaidhane, Mahalaqua Nazli Khatib, Sanjit Sah, Ganesh Bushi, Ranjana Sah, Anil Kumar
pmc-11381804.description: volved a 37-year-old man who was admitted to Yan Chai Hospital on March 21, 2024, after exhibiting symptoms of fever and altered consciousness. pmc-11433475.title: Antifungal Activity of Disalt of Epipyrone A from Epicoccum nigrum Likely via Disrupted Fatty Acid Elongation and Sphingolipid Biosynthesis
pmc-11433475.creator: Alex J. Lee, Joseph Hammond, Jeffrey Sheridan, Simon Swift, Andrew B. Munkacsi, Silas G. Villas-Boas
pmc-11433475.description: Multidrug-resistant fungal pathogens and antifungal drug toxicity have challenged our current ability to fight fungal infections. Therefore, there is a strong global demand for novel antifungal molecules with the distinct mode of action and specificity to service the medical and agricultural sectors. Polyenes are a class of antifungal drugs with the broadest spectrum of activity among the current antifungal drugs.

pmc-11444558.title: The impact of oral melatonin on pain and anxiety reduction during venipuncture in pediatric patients: a double-blind randomized clinical trial
pmc-11444558.creator: Sara Rahafard, Zohre Akbari Jokar, Seyed Ahmad Hosseini, Ehsan Alaee
pmc-11444558.description: Background:Pain resulting from therapeutic procedures and injections is a prevalent source of stress for children. Immediate side effects of pain in infants include syncope, irritability, sleep disturbances, and nutritional issues. This study aimed to investigate the effects of oral melatonin on alleviating pain and anxiety in pediatric patients undergoing venipuncture.

pmc-12373891.title: Time series forecasting of chlorophyll-a concentrations in the Chesapeake Bay
pmc-12373891.creator: Sahil Gupta, Sagar Gupta
pmc-12373891.description: Declining water quality poses serious environmental and public health risks, with chlorophyll-a serving as a key biological indicator of harmful algal blooms. This study evaluates the use of a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network to forecast chlorophyll-a concentrations in the Chesapeake Bay, a critical estuarine ecosystem supporting over 17 million people.

pmc-12538768.title: Giant cell tumor of bone in the mandible presenting without typical histological features: a case report
pmc-12538768.creator: Kaori Oya, Kouhei Kawamura, Ryou Akiyama, Hiroki Kiyokawa, Toshihiro Uchihashi, Hiroaki Shimamoto, Tadashi Sasai, Shin-Ichiro Hiraoka, Shumei Murakami, Satoru Toyosawa
pmc-12538768.description: BackgroundGiant cell tumor of bone is a locally aggressive bone tumor characterized by the proliferation of round-to-oval mononuclear cells and uniformly distributed osteoclast-type giant cells. Giant cell tumor of bone typically arises in long bones, whereas craniofacial involvement is rare. Atypical histological and clinical presentations can complicate diagnosis.

pmc-12676147.title: Transcatheter Heart Valve Postprocedural Care
pmc-12676147.creator: Evelyn H Wilder, Nicole R Dellise, Gurbir Dhaliwal, Nicole Tilson, Andre Santana, April Yeargin, Sapandip K Walia, Thomas Rhodes, Pei Hsiu Huang, David K Roberts
pmc-12676147.description: BackgroundCardiac rehabilitation (CR) referral following transcatheter heart valve procedures was suboptimal at a tertiary hospital in Northern California due to the absence of standardized internal processes.Project RationaleThe Society of Thoracic Surgeons and American College of Cardiology Transcatheter Valve Therapy Registry identify documentation of CR referral as a key quality metric.

pmc-12785472.title: Modified mRNA-Based Therapeutic Strategies for Myocardial Ischemia–Reperfusion Injury
pmc-12785472.creator: Ting Cai, Xiang-Qun Yang
pmc-12785472.description: Ischemic heart disease (IHD), the leading causes of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality worldwide, is currently treated though revascularization strategies such as pharmacological thrombolysis, coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), and percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). However, the restoration of blood flow often induces cardiac dysfunction, known as myocardial ischemia–reperfusion injury (MIRI).

pmc-12808636.title: Proteome-wide mendelian randomization reveals circulating proteins causally associated with childhood body mass index
pmc-12808636.creator: Raphael Avocegamou, Basile Jumentier, Kaossarath Fagbemi, Nahid Yazdanpanah, Mojgan Yazdanpanah, Isabel Gamache, Despoina Manousaki
pmc-12808636.description: Childhood obesity is a major public health problem, affecting one in 5 youths. We aimed to characterize biomarkers for pediatric obesity among circulating proteins using Mendelian randomization (MR). We utilized genome-wide significant cis-protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) from three large adult proteomic GWAS (N total>58,000) and a small childhood proteomic GWAS (N=2,147) as genetic instruments for circulating protein levels.

pmc-13386814.title: Effectiveness of pain neuroscience education in women with dysmenorrhea: controlled clinical trial
pmc-13386814.creator: Çiğdem Inkaya, Osman Çoban
pmc-13386814.description: BackgroundDysmenorrhea is a highly prevalent gynecological condition that negatively affects menstrual pain experience, daily activities, and overall quality of life. Pain neuroscience education (PNE) is a non-pharmacological intervention designed to reshape maladaptive pain beliefs and promote a more adaptive understanding of pain mechanisms.

pmc-13575771.title: Global, Regional, and National Burden of Self‐Harm and Projections to 2030: A Systematic Analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021
pmc-13575771.creator: Jiaying Li, Yushen Dai, Junyan Xi, Stefanos Tyrovolas, Yin Karis Ngai, Yufei Lu, Janelle Yorke, Yan Li
pmc-13575771.description: Background and AimsSelf‐harm is a global public health problem, yet comprehensive analyses of its trends and the impact of sociodemographic factors remain insufficient. This study aimed to systematically examine the spatial and temporal trends of self‐harm burden from 1990 to 2021 and forecast trends through 2030.

pmc-13682840.title: Temporal turnover and fire severity shape postfire beetle (Coleoptera) diversity at a forest range edge
pmc-13682840.creator: Briseida E Yáñez, Jane E Strobel, Valarie L Gabbard, Karalee A Corbeil, Robert M Plowes, Lawrence E Gilbert, Kenneth P Wray, Steven Gibson, Kelsey Meisenhelder, Alex Wild, Rossana Maguiña-Conde, Karl Roeder
pmc-13682840.description: In recent decades, wildfires have increased in frequency and severity, reshaping forest structure and biodiversity. Yet it remains unclear whether postfire insect assemblages are driven primarily by fire severity, vegetation structure, or broader temporal community turnover, particularly in fragmented range-edge forests.
